project.name: Automated Claim Approval
project.goal: Reduce manual processing for eligible low-risk claims while preserving fraud, financial, legal, compliance, and audit controls.

sample_requirements.statement: A claim may be automatically approved only when claim amount is <= 25000, required documentation is complete, coverage is valid, and no blocking fraud or exception condition exists.
A claim with fraud score >= 80 must be routed to manual investigation.
Payment release above 15000 requires Finance authorization even if the claim decision itself is automatically approved.

conflicts.description: Claims SOP states 25000 while Claims Policy v2.1 states 20000.

checks.name: okf_approval
checks.blocking_reason: Final OKF has not yet been generated and approved.
